business_problem: Anywhere Real Estate needed to unify the many disconnected applications its agents use every day so listing search, lead management, marketing, and transaction workflows could be handled more productively from one modern system.
solution_summary: Anywhere Real Estate is using MongoDB Atlas to consolidate the disconnected applications agents rely on for listings, lead management, marketing, and transaction workflows. At the core of the modernization are its agent API and listing API, which run on Atlas and supply many of the company’s digital services. MongoDB Professional Services helped the team with cluster sizing, performance testing, and search optimization as these workloads moved into the managed platform. Atlas Search powers fast, geospatial property discovery across millions of listings, while change streams keep updates synchronized among the applications agents and brokers use throughout the sales process. Anywhere also normalizes data from hundreds of multiple listing services into a common schema inside Atlas, giving users a more consistent foundation for search and operational workflows. The company is already evaluating Atlas Vector Search for natural-language querying and smarter lead or productivity use cases.
